description: Sidewalks 2014 is a dataset listed in State of Delaware open data portal (data.delaware.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Delaware. Graphic representation of sidewalks in Delaware with a number of attributes including type of material and year inventoried. Data is not updated on a regular basis. Updates are done when received from DelDOT. Coverage: Delaware. The table has 15 columns. The portal shows 2022-01-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-delaware-gov-portal.
